Community Partnerships

Prevention is a collective effort, strengthened by the incredible work of researchers, universities, community organizations, youth-led coalitions, and school-community partnerships. Together, these efforts advance knowledge, strengthen collaboration, and create meaningful opportunities to prevent youth homelessness before it begins.

Coalition Jeunes+

The Comité de pilotage brings together community leaders, youth with lived experience of homelessness, coalitions, and researchers to shape strategic priorities, guide collective action, and advocate for policies and systemic changes aimed at preventing and ending youth homelessness.
